source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 4 (PDF 126-141), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 4 (Differential Equations) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Find the order and degree (if defined) of: (i) \(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + \sqrt{\dfrac{dy}{dx}} = x\) (ii) \(\left(\dfrac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\right)^{2/3} = \dfrac{dy}{dx} + 1\) (iii) \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} + \tan\left(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right) = 0\) (5 marks)
(Order aur degree (agar define ho) maloom karein: (i) \(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} + \sqrt{\dfrac{dy}{dx}} = x\) (ii) \(\left(\dfrac{d^{3}y}{dx^{3}}\right)^{2/3} = \dfrac{dy}{dx} + 1\) (iii) \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} + \tan\left(\dfrac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right) = 0\))
blocks.explanation: Sab se oonchi derivative (order) pehchanein; root ya fractional power ko alag kar ke power se khatam karein; agar derivative tan jaise function ke andar ho to degree define nahi.

book_ref.quote: Answer order and degree questions in three short lines

steps: Root alag: \(\sqrt{\frac{dy}{dx}} = x - \frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\); square: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \left(x - \frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{2}\), is mein \(\left(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\right)^{2}\): degree 2
(iii) Sab se oonchi derivative \(\frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}}\), order 2; yeh \(\tan\) ke andar hai: degree define nahi
blocks.final_answer: (i) order 2, degree 2 (ii) order 3, degree 2 (iii) order 2, degree define nahi

blocks.prompt:
2 A resistor \(R\) and a capacitor \(C\) are connected in series with a DC source of constant emf \(V_{S}\). Derive the differential equation for the charge \(q\) on the capacitor and verify that \(q = CV_{S}\left(1 - e^{-t/(RC)}\right)\) satisfies it. (5 marks)
(Resistor \(R\) aur capacitor \(C\) series mein constant emf \(V_{S}\) wale DC source se jure hain. Capacitor par charge \(q\) ki differential equation derive karein aur tasdeeq karein ke \(q = CV_{S}\left(1 - e^{-t/(RC)}\right)\) ise poora karta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har hisse ka voltage likhein, Kirchhoff's voltage law se jama karein, phir I ki jagah dq/dt rakhein; tasdeeq ke liye differentiate karein.

book_ref.quote: Method: write the voltage across each component, then use Kirchhoff's voltage law

steps: Capacitor ka voltage \(V_{C} = \frac{q}{C}\); resistor ka (Ohm's law) \(V_{R} = IR\)
Kirchhoff's voltage law: \(V_{S} = V_{R} + V_{C} = IR + \frac{q}{C}\)
Aur \(CV_{S} - q = CV_{S}e^{-t/(RC)}\): dono taraf barabar
blocks.final_answer: \(RC\dfrac{dq}{dt} = CV_{S} - q\); saabit hua ke \(q = CV_{S}\left(1 - e^{-t/(RC)}\right)\) ise poora karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 Find the general solution of \((1 + e^{x})\,y\,dy = e^{x}\,dx\), and the particular solution with \(y(0) = 0\). (5 marks)
(\((1 + e^{x})\,y\,dy = e^{x}\,dx\) ka general solution, aur \(y(0) = 0\) wala particular solution nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Alag karne ke liye (1 + e^x) se taqseem karein; x wale integral mein upar denominator ka derivative hai.

book_ref.quote: By solving the integrals on both sides, we obtain the general solution of separable differential equation.

blocks.final_answer: General: \(y^{2} = 2\ln(1 + e^{x}) + c\); particular: \(y^{2} = 2\ln\dfrac{1 + e^{x}}{2}\).

blocks.prompt:
4 Solve the initial value problem \(2y\dfrac{dy}{dx} = xe^{x}\), \(y(0) = 2\). (5 marks)
(Initial value problem \(2y\dfrac{dy}{dx} = xe^{x}\), \(y(0) = 2\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: Alag karein, daen taraf by parts integrate karein, phir initial condition se constant nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Method: separate, integrate both sides, add one constant.

blocks.prompt:
5 Solve \(x\dfrac{dy}{dx} = y^{2} - 1\) (\(x > 0\)) with \(y(1) = 3\), and express \(y\) explicitly. (5 marks)
(\(x\dfrac{dy}{dx} = y^{2} - 1\) (\(x > 0\)), \(y(1) = 3\) hal karein aur \(y\) ko seedha likhein.)
blocks.explanation: y aur x alag karein; 1/(y^2 - 1) ke partial fractions banayein, integrate karein, phir y(1) = 3 lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Separable means \(\frac{dy}{dx} = g(x)\,h(y)\)

steps: Integrate: \(\frac{1}{2}\ln\left|\frac{y - 1}{y + 1}\right| = \ln x + c_{1}\), is liye \(\frac{y - 1}{y + 1} = Ax^{2}\)

blocks.prompt:
6 Solve the initial value problem \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \sin x\cos^{2}y\), \(y(0) = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\), and check the answer by differentiation. (5 marks)
(Initial value problem \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \sin x\cos^{2}y\), \(y(0) = \dfrac{\pi}{4}\) hal karein aur differentiate kar ke jawab check karein.)
blocks.explanation: cos^2 y se taqseem kar ke alag karein (baen sec^2 y), integrate karein, constant nikalein, phir jawab differentiate karein.

book_ref.quote: Check by differentiating the answer: you must get the original equation back.

blocks.final_answer: \(\tan y = 2 - \cos x\)

blocks.prompt:
7 Show that the substitution \(y = vx\) turns \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = F\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right)\) into a separable equation, and use it to solve \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{2x^{2}}\). (5 marks)
(Dikhayein ke substitution \(y = vx\), \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = F\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right)\) ko separable bana deti hai, aur is se \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{2x^{2}}\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: y = vx ko product rule se differentiate karein, rakhein, v tafreeq kar ke alag karein; phir x = 1, y = v se F(v) nikal kar lagayein.

book_ref.quote: can be converted into a separable differential equation in variables

steps: \(y = vx\) se \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\), aur \(F\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = F(v)\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua (separable shakal \(\dfrac{dv}{F(v) - v} = \dfrac{dx}{x}\)); general solution \(\dfrac{2x}{x - y} = \ln|cx|\).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: \(\int\frac{2\,dv}{(1 - v)^{2}}\): \((1 - v)^{-2}\) ka integral power rule se \(\frac{(1 - v)^{-1}}{-1} \cdot (-1) = \frac{1}{1 - v}\) hai (andar ka derivative \(-1\) sign badal deta hai). Is liye jawab \(\frac{2}{1 - v}\).

blocks.prompt:
8 Solve \(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{y^{2} - x^{2}}{2xy}\), and find the particular solution through \((1, 1)\). (5 marks)
(\(\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{y^{2} - x^{2}}{2xy}\) hal karein, aur \((1, 1)\) se guzarne wala particular solution nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har term ki degree 2, is liye homogeneous: y = vx rakhein, v aur x alag karein, integrate karein, v = y/x wapas rakhein.

book_ref.quote: if every term of the numerator and of the denominator has the same degree

blocks.final_answer: General solution \(x^{2} + y^{2} = cx\); particular solution \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 2x\).

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the general solution of \(x\dfrac{dy}{dx} = y + x\sec\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right)\). (5 marks)
(\(x\dfrac{dy}{dx} = y + x\sec\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right)\) ka general solution nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: x se taqseem kar ke dy/dx ko y/x ka function banayein; phir y = vx se separable ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: can easily be simplified by replacing

blocks.final_answer: \(\sin\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right) = \ln|cx|\)

blocks.prompt:
10 Solve the initial value problem \((x - y)\,dy = (x + y)\,dx\), \(y(1) = 0\). (5 marks)
(Initial value problem \((x - y)\,dy = (x + y)\,dx\), \(y(1) = 0\) hal karein.)
blocks.explanation: dy/dx = (x + y)/(x - y) likhein, homogeneous hai; y = vx, alag karein, v wale integral ko do standard integrals mein torein.

book_ref.quote: It becomes separable differential equation.

steps: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + y}{x - y}\); \(y = vx\): \(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + v}{1 - v}\)
blocks.final_answer: \(\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right) = \dfrac{1}{2}\ln(x^{2} + y^{2})\)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: \(\ln(1 + v^{2}) = \ln\frac{x^{2} + y^{2}}{x^{2}} = \ln(x^{2} + y^{2}) - 2\ln|x|\). Is ka aadha \(\frac{1}{2}\ln(x^{2} + y^{2}) - \ln|x|\) hai, is liye minus ke baad \(+\ln|x|\) aata hai jo daen taraf ke \(\ln|x|\) se cancel ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 An RL circuit has constant emf \(V_{S}\), resistance \(R\), inductance \(L\) and \(I(0) = 0\). Starting from \(L\dfrac{dI}{dt} = V_{S} - RI\), show that \(I = \dfrac{V_{S}}{R}\left(1 - e^{-Rt/L}\right)\). (5 marks)
(RL circuit: constant emf \(V_{S}\), resistance \(R\), inductance \(L\), \(I(0) = 0\). \(L\dfrac{dI}{dt} = V_{S} - RI\) se shuru kar ke dikhayein ke \(I = \dfrac{V_{S}}{R}\left(1 - e^{-Rt/L}\right)\).)
blocks.explanation: Equation separable hai: I wali terms dI ke saath aur t, dt ke saath; integrate karein aur I(0) = 0 se constant nikalein.

book_ref.quote: use the RL circuit model, which is separable

steps: \(t = 0\) par fraction 1 (positive) hai, is liye \(\frac{V_{S} - RI}{V_{S}} = e^{-Rt/L}\)
blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(I = \dfrac{V_{S}}{R}\left(1 - e^{-Rt/L}\right)\); \(t \to \infty\) par \(I \to \dfrac{V_{S}}{R}\).

blocks.prompt:
12 A body at temperature \(T_{0}\) at \(t = 0\) is placed in surroundings at constant temperature \(T_{S}\). Using \(\dfrac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_{S})\), \(k > 0\), show that \(T = T_{S} + (T_{0} - T_{S})e^{-kt}\), and explain what happens as \(t \to \infty\). (5 marks)
(\(t = 0\) par \(T_{0}\) temperature wali cheez constant temperature \(T_{S}\) ke mahol mein rakhi gayi. \(\dfrac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_{S})\), \(k > 0\) se dikhayein ke \(T = T_{S} + (T_{0} - T_{S})e^{-kt}\), aur batayein \(t \to \infty\) par kya hota hai.)
blocks.explanation: T aur t alag karein, integrate karein, constant ln|c| likhein, logarithm hatayein aur T(0) = T_0 lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Cooling / heating in surroundings at

blocks.final_answer: Saabit hua: \(T = T_{S} + (T_{0} - T_{S})e^{-kt}\); aakhir mein cheez mahol ka temperature \(T_{S}\) le leti hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 Starting from \(\dfrac{dM}{dt} = -kM\), \(M(0) = M_{0}\), show that the half-life is \(T_{1/2} = \dfrac{\ln 2}{k}\), independent of \(M_{0}\). A sample of 48 g has half-life 5 hours: find \(k\) and the mass left after 20 hours. (5 marks)
(\(\dfrac{dM}{dt} = -kM\), \(M(0) = M_{0}\) se dikhayein ke half-life \(T_{1/2} = \dfrac{\ln 2}{k}\) hai, jo \(M_{0}\) par munhasir nahi. 48 g sample ki half-life 5 ghante hai: \(k\) aur 20 ghante baad bacha hua mass nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Decay equation hal karein, M ko M_0 ka aadha rakhein, ln lein; phir formula lagayein aur half-lives ginein.

book_ref.quote: Half-life is the time required for a quantity of a radioactive substance to reduce to half of its initial amount due to radioactive decay.

blocks.final_answer: \(T_{1/2} = \dfrac{\ln 2}{k}\) (saabit hua); \(k \approx 0.1386\) per ghanta; 20 ghante baad 3 g bachega.

blocks.prompt:
14 A culture has 300 bacteria initially and the number triples in 4 hours. Find (i) the number after 10 hours (ii) the time when the number reaches 5000. (5 marks)
(Culture mein shuru mein 300 bacteria hain aur 4 ghante mein teen guna ho jate hain. (i) 10 ghante baad tadaad (ii) 5000 tak pohanchne ka waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Growth model dN/dt = kN: N(0) se constant, N(4) se k; e^{4k} = 3 ko exact rakhein, aakhir mein round karein.

book_ref.quote: the population grows at a rate proportional to its size

blocks.final_answer: (i) taqreeban 4677 bacteria (ii) taqreeban 10.24 ghante

blocks.prompt:
15 A radioactive substance has mass 120 g initially and 90 g after 6 hours. Find (i) the decay constant (ii) the mass after 15 hours (iii) the time when 30 g remain. (5 marks)
(Radioactive maadde ka mass shuru mein 120 g aur 6 ghante baad 90 g hai. (i) decay constant (ii) 15 ghante baad mass (iii) 30 g bachne ka waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: dM/dt = -kM, M = 120e^{-kt}; doosri reading se e^{-6k} = 3/4, is se har hissa exact nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: radioactive mass decays at a rate proportional to the mass present

blocks.final_answer: (i) \(k \approx 0.0479\) per ghanta (ii) taqreeban 58.46 g (iii) taqreeban 28.91 ghante

blocks.prompt:
16 A metal block at \(200^{\circ}\)C is placed in a room at \(30^{\circ}\)C. After 10 minutes its temperature is \(150^{\circ}\)C. Find (i) its temperature after 30 minutes (ii) when it reaches \(50^{\circ}\)C. (5 marks)
(\(200^{\circ}\)C ka dhaat ka tukra \(30^{\circ}\)C ke kamre mein rakha gaya. 10 minute baad \(150^{\circ}\)C hai. (i) 30 minute baad temperature (ii) \(50^{\circ}\)C kab hoga, nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Newton's law dT/dt = -k(T - 30): T = 30 + 170e^{-kt}; 10 minute wali reading se e^{-10k} = 12/17.

book_ref.quote: the rate of cooling is proportional to the difference from the room temperature

blocks.final_answer: (i) taqreeban \(89.79^{\circ}\)C (ii) taqreeban 61.44 minute baad

blocks.prompt:
17 Under steady inflation the price of an item rose from Rs. 2500 to Rs. 3200 in 4 years. Assuming the rate of change of price is proportional to the price, find the inflation rate and the price after 10 years. (5 marks)
(Musalsal inflation mein aik cheez ki qeemat 4 saal mein Rs. 2500 se Rs. 3200 ho gayi. Qeemat ki rate of change ko qeemat ke proportional maan kar inflation rate aur 10 saal baad ki qeemat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Model dP/dt = kP: P = 2500e^{kt}; P(4) se e^{4k} = 1.28, is se k aur phir P(10).

book_ref.quote: Growth (bacteria, money, inflation)

blocks.final_answer: Inflation rate taqreeban \(6.17\%\) salana; 10 saal baad qeemat taqreeban Rs. 4634.10.

blocks.prompt:
18 An RL circuit has emf 24 V, resistance \(8\ \Omega\), inductance 4 H and no initial current. Solve the differential equation for \(I(t)\), find the current after 1 second and the steady current. (5 marks)
(RL circuit: emf 24 V, resistance \(8\ \Omega\), inductance 4 H, shuru mein current zero. \(I(t)\) ke liye differential equation hal karein, 1 second baad current aur steady current nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: L dI/dt = V_S - RI mein qeematein rakhein, alag karein, integrate karein, I(0) = 0 lagayein.

book_ref.quote: the steady current of Ohm's law

blocks.final_answer: \(I(t) = 3\left(1 - e^{-2t}\right)\) A; \(I(1) \approx 2.594\) A; steady current 3 A.

blocks.prompt:
19 An uncharged capacitor of \(C = 0.2\) F is charged through \(R = 5\ \Omega\) by a 10 V source. Solve \(RC\dfrac{dq}{dt} = CV_{S} - q\) for \(q(t)\), find the current \(I(t)\), and the time when the charge reaches 90% of its final value. (5 marks)
(\(C = 0.2\) F ka khaali capacitor \(R = 5\ \Omega\) ke zariye 10 V source se charge hota hai. \(RC\dfrac{dq}{dt} = CV_{S} - q\) se \(q(t)\), current \(I(t)\), aur charge ke aakhri qeemat ka 90% hone ka waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Yahan RC = 1 aur CV_S = 2; q(0) = 0 ke saath separable equation hal karein, I ke liye differentiate karein, aur q = 0.9 CV_S hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Our summary of the models used in this section (not printed in the book)

blocks.final_answer: \(q = 2\left(1 - e^{-t}\right)\) C, \(I = 2e^{-t}\) A; 90% charge \(\ln 10 \approx 2.303\) s baad.

blocks.prompt:
20 A 50 mg dose of a medicine is in the blood at t = 0. The body removes it at a rate proportional to the amount present, with constant 0.3 per hour. Construct the model, solve it, and find (i) the amount after 4 hours (ii) when only 10 mg remain. (5 marks)
(t = 0 par khoon mein dawai ki 50 mg miqdaar hai. Jism ise maujood miqdaar ke proportional raftaar se nikalta hai, constant 0.3 per ghanta. Model banayein, hal karein, aur (i) 4 ghante baad miqdaar (ii) 10 mg kab bachegi, nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Jumle ka tarjuma karein (rate = dA/dt, proportional = constant zarb, kami = minus), separable equation hal karein, phir qeematein rakhein.

book_ref.quote: First-order differential equations play a vital role in modeling various real-life phenomena

steps: Model: \(\frac{dA}{dt} = -0.3A\) (miqdaar kam hoti hai is liye minus)
blocks.final_answer: \(A = 50e^{-0.3t}\); (i) taqreeban 15.06 mg (ii) taqreeban 5.36 ghante baad
